description: This file defines the 'google_breakpad::Module' class and related structures, which represent debugging information, functions, source files, and symbol data for a module in the Breakpad crash reporting system.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a software module's debugging and symbol information, supporting methods for adding functions, source files, externs, and writing symbol data to a stream.

classes.name: Module::File
classes.description: Represents a source file associated with the module.

classes.name: Module::Function
classes.description: Represents a function within the module, including its address, size, name, and source lines.

classes.name: Module::Line
classes.description: Represents a source line within a function, including address, size, file, and line number.

classes.name: Module::Extern
classes.description: Represents an externally visible symbol with an address and name.

classes.name: Module::StackFrameEntry
classes.description: Represents stack frame information for stack unwinding.

methods.name: Module::SetLoadAddress
methods.description: Sets the module's load address, affecting how addresses are written relative to this base.

methods.name: Module::AddFunction
methods.description: Adds a function to the module.

methods.name: Module::AddFunctions
methods.description: Adds multiple functions to the module.

methods.name: Module::AddStackFrameEntry
methods.description: Adds a stack frame entry for stack unwinding.

methods.name: Module::AddExtern
methods.description: Adds an external symbol to the module.

methods.name: Module::FindFile
methods.description: Finds or creates a source file by name.

methods.name: Module::FindExistingFile
methods.description: Finds an existing source file by name.

methods.name: Module::GetFunctions
methods.description: Retrieves pointers to functions in the module.

methods.name: Module::GetExterns
methods.description: Retrieves pointers to externs in the module.

methods.name: Module::GetFiles
methods.description: Retrieves pointers to source files in the module.

methods.name: Module::GetStackFrameEntries
methods.description: Retrieves pointers to stack frame entries.

methods.name: Module::AssignSourceIds
methods.description: Assigns source IDs to files based on their usage.

methods.name: Module::Write
methods.description: Writes the module's symbol data to an output stream.
